fields.label: Department
fields.note: job.department in the board payload; the public posting API has no server-side filter.

notes: Atlan's careers page is its own JS listing that fetches the Ashby public posting API https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/atlan; live response returned 7 jobs with department (Engineering/Marketing/Sales), location, employmentType (FullTime) and workplaceType (Remote) fields. That public endpoint returns the full board in one response and exposes no keyword or facet parameters, and job details are selected by ?id=<uuid> on atlan.com/careers/jobs/, so every filter is applied locally.
